source_wording_notes.normalization: Literal source forms preferred. Short lexical heads inside clauses and singular/plural/case/wrapped forms are explicit normalized aliases; qualifiers omitted by broad cues are not quoted as encoded.
source_wording_notes.reuse_scan: Every term searched across banks1-41, catalog and sound workshops using exact and meaningful substring heads. Search results saved. Family mappings reviewed against actual referenced ingredients; heuristic, not proof of semantic completeness.
source_wording_notes.collisions: Broad heart, engine/angina, vessel, pain mask, pear/cardigan, rhythm, name fragments and anatomy models require learned context. Shared props do not discriminate conditions, subtypes or mechanisms. No novelty, clinical equivalence or proven recall claim.
source_wording_notes.calibration: A familiar location/topic prop alone is insufficient. Current holds include lung-only pneumonia, germ-only sepsis, ECG-only aVR/R and heart-only reinfarction/limiting infarct size. Prior drafts preserved on changed entries. Other anatomy/word-head families explicitly partial: myo-/muscle, cardio-/heart, rib/cost-, derm-/skin, gastr-/stomach, valve, ventricle, artery and branch. Counts measure tried terms, not full-name coverage.
source_wording_notes.name_fragments: Mitre/mitral, stem/STEM, street/ST, tea/T, cue/Q, well/Wells/Wellen/Wellens, clock/clopi-, ticket/tica-, ox/enox-/digox-, cane/strepto-kinase ending, metronome/meto-, tent/ten-/aten-, fiber/fib-, bee/pea B/peptide, amethyst/amy-, sack/sarc-, boar/Boer-, dimes/dimer, and other partials are contextual proposals with naming/pronunciation collisions, not full-name recovery. Aspirin explicitly revisits an older rejected asp/ring attempt; species recognition is unresolved.
source_wording_notes.source_aliases: ASCII beta-blockers is an explicit spelling of the source Greek beta glyph. Tachy- is literal elision in Table48-5. Wellen's sign is actual Table49-5 form, not silently corrected to Wellens'. URL is upper reference limit, held without web association.
source_wording_notes.independent_audit_repairs: Author addressed B report items1-6 and invisible ABC block; prior changed draft attempts preserved. Directional arrows explicitly reoriented from actual older arrow ingredient; specific prior roots used for aorta, ulcer, asystole, contractions, stem, eraser and tea. Added demographic/table descriptor/anatomy and full-width-table footnote head trials before excluding numerical/clinical relationships. Author checks are not B final recheck or main integration approval.
